title: Chiropractor (Stevens Point, WI)
description:
Chiropractor – Stevens Point, Wisconsin
Chiro One Wellness Centers

This is a role for a chiropractor who wants to focus on patient care, utilize and grow their clinical confidence, and be part of a team that’s built to support.

What your days look like:
You’ll step into a clinic designed for flow, where your focus stays on patient care. You’ll evaluate patients, review X-rays, deliver adjustments, and guide care plans that evolve with progress

You won’t be managing everything alone. Chiropractic Assistants support patient flow, exercises, and scheduling, while on-site imaging allows you to assess, diagnose, and treat in real time. Between visits, you’ll collaborate with your team, track outcomes, and stay connected to each patient’s progress.

What We Offer:

  • Base salary (starting at 70k, negotiable) + bonus compensation (see below). Pay is biweekly.
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to clinic outcomes & growth (not per adjustment)
  • Full medical, dental, vision + PTO, holidays, life/disability insurance for you and your team, plus malpractice insurance
  • Sponsored CE, leadership training, and business development
  • Back-office support (legal, marketing, HR, IT, revenue cycle, clinical ops and more)
  • Paid training & onboarding including

Why Chiro One is Different:

  • Full Patient Care Model - Evidence-based treatment models allowing you to review X-rays assess, and create care progression. Our model supports whole-patient care
  • No Buy-In or Franchise Fees - earn like an operator, without taking on financial risk or overhead.
  • Clinical Autonomy with Support - Our doctors shape care plans and patient experience, they are not assembly-line providers. Most Clinics have 1-2 Chiropractic Assistants on site
  • World Class Training Model - DCs experience hands-on training with our skilled Physician Trainers and with Clinic Directors. Doctors are set up for success by being trained on our systems and processes.
  • Leadership & Clinic Director Track - Grow into leadership without having to purchase or franchise a clinic.
  • Mentorship & Professional Development - We invest in leadership growth and ongoing clinical mastery, not just onboarding.

At Chiro One, care is built around outcomes and you’re not doing it in isolation. You’ll be part of a broader network of chiropractors—people you can learn from, collaborate with, and grow alongside.

Job Requirements:

  • Degree from an accredited university/college of Chiropractic
  • Chiropractic License in the state of Wisconsin or intent to obtain
  • Encourages accountability among team members and patients.
  • Promotes a balanced, healthy lifestyle centered on chiropractic.
  • Performance-driven, loves goals and metrics
  • Possesses strong ability to create, plan and achieve goals.
  • Uses clear and professional verbal and written communication.
  • Possesses ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

title: Licensed Surveyor
description:
Timmons Group is currently seeking a Licensed Surveyor to join our Survey Group located in our Wilmington, NC office location. The Licensed Surveyor is responsible for the successful management of assigned projects and for the management of assigned client accounts. The successful candidate will manage/perform design related surveying projects using relevant office software, modeling and CADD technology.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Project Management
  • Responsible for marketing and client development, technical quality, profitability, schedule, project staff coordination, client communications
  • Proposal preparation, negotiating scopes and fees, billing, client follow-up maintenance and assistance in collection of fees when required
  • The Licensed Surveyor must maintain superior relationships with each of his/her clients and cross-sell Timmons Group services which fall outside of his/her direct professional expertise
  • An ability to manage several mid-sized projects, multiple small projects or a single larger project simultaneously is required
  • The successful candidate will be able to manage/perform projects that may include ALTA/NSPS Land Title, boundary, route, topographical, construction, control networking and high definition surveys
  • The Licensed Surveyor is expected to perform calculations using surveying formulas and skills and/or utilizes computers in order to solve problems
  • Ongoing communication with the Group Leader, clients, staff and internal design team is essential

Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in surveying, geomatics, engineering or a scientific area and/or equivalent work experience and professional registration (L.S., P.E., etc.) in one or more states in which Timmons Group conducts business is required.
  • Has 6 + years of land surveying experience.
  • Working knowledge and experience using Civil 3D, MicroStation or equivalent CAD software
  • Working knowledge and experience using Leica, Trimble or equivalent survey data reduction software
  • Working knowledge and experience creating Machine Control Models
  • Working knowledge and experience utilizing GPS/RTK technology
  • Preference will be given to those having a working knowledge and experience using Laser Scanning Technology
  • Must have a thorough understanding of project accounting and demonstrated ability to manage the schedule and budget for multiple projects at the same time
  • Has experience in client development and supervision of the technical work of others (Survey Technicians and field crews)
  • Has a working knowledge of technical and office support software required to perform the essential functions of the position
  • We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace
  • Candidate must share a commitment to our company’s Mission and Shared Values

title: Senior Analyst, Consumer Credit & Residual Value Risk
description:
Overview

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

An important part of the Toyota family is Toyota Financial Services (TFS), the finance and insurance brand for Toyota and Lexus in North America. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.



Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.

Who we’re looking for

Toyota Financial Savings Bank (TFSB) Credit Risk department is seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Analyst, Consumer Credit & Residual Value Risk to join the team.

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead credit and residual value risk analytics, portfolio monitoring, and reporting across consumer portfolios. This role is suited for a strong individual contributor with deep expertise in consumer credit risk, residual value risk, regulatory compliance, and risk strategy assessment.

Reporting to the Manager of Consumer Risk, the person in this role will support the TFSB Credit Risk department’s objective to strengthen credit and residual value risk oversight through data-driven insights, robust analytics, and clear reporting for senior management, board, and regulatory stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring advanced technical capabilities, sound business acumen, and the ability to work independently while partnering effectively across teams to deliver accurate, actionable insights.

What you’ll be doing

  • Monitor consumer credit performance across auto loan, auto lease, and mortgage portfolios.
  • Lead the development and oversight of residual value risk analytics, monitoring, and reporting for the auto lease portfolio.
  • Analyze origination trends, portfolio behavior, delinquency, losses, recoveries, and other key risk metrics.
  • Track key risk indicators and threshold exceptions; identify emerging risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reporting for senior management.
  • Support analysis and reporting for regulatory exams, audits, and compliance-related inquiries.
  • Develop materials for the board of directors and executive-level risk committees.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders across risk, finance, credit, operations, compliance, and servicing.
  • Maintain documentation, methodologies, and data quality standards for portfolio risk reporting.
  • Assist in the development of dashboards, scorecards, and analytics that improve risk visibility.
  • Contribute to policy, process, and control enhancements related to portfolio monitoring.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in consumer credit risk, portfolio analytics, or related financial analysis.
  • Experience with auto lending, auto leasing, or consumer portfolio management, including knowledge of credit risk frameworks, residual value risk concepts, and portfolio monitoring practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated experience in data analysis and reporting tools such as Excel, SQL, Python, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to interpret large datasets and communicate complex findings in a clear, concise manner.
  • Experience preparing materials for senior leadership, board reporting, or regulatory examinations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Added bonus if you have

  • Certificates in Tableau or Power BI
  • Experience with credit policy, loss forecasting, or risk governance processes.
  • Familiarity with regulatory expectations for consumer lending.

What We’ll Bring

During your interview process, our team can fill you in on all the details of our industry-leading benefits and career development opportunities. A few highlights include:

  • A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect
  • Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement
  • Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount
  • Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable)
  • Comprehensive health care and wellness plans for your entire family
  • Toyota 401(k) Savings Plan featuring a company match, as well as an annual retirement contribution from Toyota regardless of whether you contribute (if applicable)
  • Paid holidays and paid time off
  • Referral services related to prenatal services, adoption, childcare, schools and more
  • Tax Advantaged Accounts (Health Savings Account, Health Care FSA, Dependent Care FSA)
  • Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Belonging at Toyota


Our success begins and ends with our people. We embrace all perspectives and value unique human experiences. Respect for all is our North Star.


Applicants for our positions are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, religion, military or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Systems Administrator II
description:
Location: Panama City, FL
Job Type: Full-Time
Security Clearance: Secret


AERMOR is seeking a skilled Systems Administrator II who will be responsible for the installation, configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrading of hardware and software components. This includes supporting the Naval Surface Warfare Center Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) RDT&E network, government servers connected to NMCI/NGEN, and other systems to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability. The role requires expertise in server and network administration, security compliance, and system performance monitoring.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Install, configure, troubleshoot, upgrade, and maintain workstations, servers, and network components.
  • Support virtualization infrastructure including VMware, Windows, Linux, and Cisco systems.
  • Perform application additions, relocations, and removals as needed.
  • Administer server-based systems, security devices, distributed applications, network storage, backups, and messaging.
  • Implement Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and maintain baseline system security in accordance with organizational policies.
  • Perform systems monitoring and troubleshooting to ensure network sustainability and security.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD IT requirements, including STIGs and Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements.
  • Work with government personnel to maintain system security and adherence to industry standards.
  • Implement and analyze security policies for Navy RMF and NAVSEA networks.
  • Provide technical consultation on network, applications, and customer service issues.
  • Support DRMO (Defense Reutilization and Marketing Office) processes, including equipment declassification, hard drive destruction, and administrative support for required documentation.
  • Receive and report work assignments via a web-based government application.
  • Work closely with the network operations team to accomplish assigned tasks.
  • Provide timely updates on in-progress and completed work.
  • Assist in coordinating equipment movement and disposal as directed by Network Operations.

Required Qualifications:
  • Must have 3+ years of experience and SEC+ certification or equivalent.
  • Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Associate, VMware Certified Technical Associate, and Red Hat Certified System Administrator.
  • Professional experience with configuration and administration of VMware products, Windows Server, and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
  • Understanding and implementation of DoD IT security requirements, including STIGs and RMF.
  • Prior experience working with DoD networks, with a preference for Navy RMF and NAVSEA networks.

title: Senior Business Process Manager (m/f/d)
description:
umdasch The Store Makers is strengthening its group-wide process, quality and transformation capability. You will work closely with business leaders, Process Owners, operational teams and ISPC. You will have a company-wide mandate and coordinate internal and external support, without disciplinary responsibility.

Your responsibilities

  • Build and continuously develop the USM-wide Business Process Management system, including process architecture, BPMN 2.0 conventions, governance, standards, metadata and lifecycle
  • Establish and enable accountable End-to-End Process Owners and lead priority process transformations across Engineering, Supply Chain and Project Delivery
  • Analyse current processes, interfaces, roles, risks, data and systems, and translate insights into pragmatic target processes, controls, KPI logic and improvement roadmaps
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops, governance decisions and pilots. Align local requirements into sustainable standards or transparent variants, and enable Process Owners and users through practical guidance and training
  • Drive digitalisation, automation, data-driven decision-making and AI-enabled process design, including opportunities in process mining and workflow automation
  • Own and continuously develop the company-wide Quality Management System and ISO certification framework, including audits, management reviews, corrective actions and certification activities
  • Report progress, risks, decisions, resource requirements and measurable benefits to management, and maintain the BPM roadmap
  • Develop the leading process repository and the Signavio set-up for approved process architecture and models, with clear interfaces to ConSense as the Quality Management and controlled-document environment

Your profile

  • Several years of experience in Business Process Management, Operational Excellence, transformation or a comparable senior advisory or leadership role
  • Proven experience with enterprise process architectures, governance models and end-to-end process improvement in an international environment
  • Strong command of process modelling, preferably BPMN 2.0, Process Ownership, KPI design and the management of controlled process variants
  • Experience in project-oriented engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, construction, fit-out or delivery environments
  • Practical understanding of ERP, PLM/PDM, CAD/BIM, CRM, collaboration and document-management systems
  • Experience with BPM platforms, process mining, workflow automation and AI-enabled process work.
  • Proven experience with Quality Management Systems, ISO certification and audit management. A lead-auditor qualification is an advantage
  • A degree or equivalent advanced training in business, engineering, business informatics, process management or a related discipline is an advantage
  • A pragmatic, analytical and fact-based working style with high ownership, delivery focus and strong digital and AI affinity
  • Business-fluent German and English, with willingness to work internationally and travel as required

What we offer

  • A varied role in an innovative, international environment, where you can contribute your creativity and continue to develop professionally
  • An open, appreciative team environment, attractive social benefits, employee catering, flexible working hours, company parking and good public transport connections
  • An attractive salary starting from EUR 5,500 gross per month based on full-time employment (38.5 hours per week). Depending on qualifications and relevant professional experience, a significant overpayment is possible

title: Park Ambassador
description:
Work in a West Coast rainforest! Surround yourself with ancient trees, bridges, canyons, critters, and an incredible, fun-loving team who work together to build an amazing and authentic experience for guests from around the world. At Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, we pride ourselves on delivering a truly unique guest experience unlike any other, inspired by our natural setting. We share our passion about history, the wonder of nature and yummy eats & treats with over 1,000,000 annual guests! We are looking for friendly and enthusiastic Park Ambassadors motivated by providing exceptional guest service.

Are you passionate about creating amazing experiences for guests?
Do you enjoy inspiring and motivating a team?
Is this the experience you’re looking for? If so, read on to find out more about the role!

What You’ll Do
  • Engage with guests as they access our attractions, provide relevant facts and information
  • Run our attraction safety positions as trained
  • To deliver programmed content in each station in an engaging manner and as trained (includes Safety Talks)
  • Ensure line-ups are moving in an orderly fashion as trained
  • Encourage Guests to partake in our park offerings such as Tours, Rainforest Explorer Program, and other seasonal activities

  • 30% discount off regular-priced merchandise at The Trading Post Gift Store
  • 30% discount at Stanley's Bar & Grill and Prospect Point Café
  • 30% discount on food items in The Cliff House Restaurant, Loggers' Grill, Beary Waffle, and The Cabin (does not apply to alcohol)

The Capilano Group comprises of retail, hospitality and tourism-based businesses anchored by Capilano Suspension Bridge Park in North Vancouver. The Capilano Group’s portfolio includes Moraine Lake Lodge, Moraine Lake Trading and Cathedral Mountain Lodge in the Canadian Rockies, Stanley Park Pavilion, Stanley’s Park Bar & Grill and Prospect Point Café and Gift Shop in Stanley Park, Vancouver and Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, Capilano Trading Post in North Vancouver.

description:

Toyota’s Powertrain Certification & Compliance Department is looking for a passionate and highly motivated certification engineer.

The primary responsibility of this position is to oversee the light duty vehicle emission and fuel economy certification and in-use testing for Toyota.

Reporting to the Manager of Powertrain Certification and Compliance, the person in this role will collaborate with the certification team management, engineers, and technicians; as well as local and Japan-based related departments, to manage planning and execution of testing, provide technical guidance, and review, analyze and report results to ensure compliance with federal and California emission and fuel economy regulatory requirements.


What you’ll be doing

Testing Program Functions


  • Manage annual and weekly test plans and schedule for Certification and In-use Emission testing and implement planned testing activities with minimal supervision.
  • Oversee and coordinate off-site NA-based test labs in Los Angeles and Denver, particularly for in-use testing and vehicle procurement.
  • Planning and oversight for test resources, including financial resources (Hundreds of thousands of $ / year), personnel resources (5 + technicians), and facility resources (two chassis dyno cells, one evaporative emission shed, one refueling shed and one environmental chamber in Ann Arbor, MI; two chassis dyno cells in Gardena, CA; high altitude testing in Denver Colorado).
  • Coordinate and provide technical direction and guidance in certification and in-use exhaust and evaporative emission testing to assigned test technicians.
  • Identify, investigate, confirm, report, monitor, track, and follow-up until resolution for certification testing related issues.

Analysis, Collaboration and Communication Functions


  • Analyze and verify the validity of emissions and fuel economy test data, generate technical reports, and distribute to both internal/external departments and government agencies.
  • Review and verify accuracy of outgoing documentation to internal/external departments and government agencies.
  • Manage vehicle procurement for testing through select vendors, and maintain good relationships with those vendors to ensure successful completion of in-use testing.
  • Establish professional working relationships with Japan-based and local experts and communicate on a regular basis.
  • Develop new procedures and tools for certification related testing and data analysis to promote continuous improvement.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and or other technical/related disciplines.
  • Minimum of 2 years of engineering work experience; (co-op/internship experience will be considered).
  • Experience in Emissions/Fuel Economy Development or certifications.
  • Understanding of Emissions/Fuel Economy performance and applicable testing procedures.
  • Proficient understanding of Internal Combustion engine theory and practice, and engine control system operation.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and project management tools such as MS Project/Excel.
  • Willingness to work overtime to accomplish project goals (generally up to 20%, including weekends), and ability to travel for business (domestic and international).

Added bonus if you have

  • Advanced degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and or other technical/related disciplines.
  • Familiarity with EPA & CARB light-duty vehicle emissions and fuel economy regulations.
  • Experience with MATLAB/Simulink/C/C++ or other programming languages.
  • Emission, bench, or OBD calibration experience in conventional and hybrid powertrain.
  • Vehicle data acquisition experience (INCA, Vehicle Spy, etc.).
  • Experience in handling big data.
  • Experience working in a team and working well in a culturally diverse environment.
  • Strong communication skills to work with and present to local management, local affiliates, Japanese affiliates, and government agencies.
  • Knowledge of engineering principles along with analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Knowledge of Toyota product line-up and emission control systems.
  • This position requires driving. A motor vehicle record that’s acceptable by company standards is required for this position.
  • Proficient Japanese language skills helpful.

What we’ll bring

Belonging at Toyota


Our success begins and ends with our people. We embrace all perspectives and value unique human experiences. Respect for all is our North Star.

title: Shop Foreman
description:
Shop Foreman

Standard Equipment - Elmhurst, Illinois

About the Role

The Shop Foreman is responsible for overseeing the daily workflow of the service shop, coordinating and assigning work to technicians based on skill level, workload, and job priority. This operational leadership role provides technical guidance and support to technicians, monitors repair quality and productivity, ensures work is completed safely and efficiently, and promotes compliance with company and manufacturer standards. The Shop Foreman works closely with the Service, Parts, and Operations teams to optimize shop performance, minimize downtime, support technician development, and deliver exceptional service to customers.

Position Responsibilities
Shop Operations & Workflow:

  • Coordinate and prioritize daily shop activities, assigning work based on technician skill level, workload, and repair urgency.
  • Monitor work order progress and adjust schedules to ensure efficient turnaround times and minimal equipment downtime.
  • Monitor shop productivity and labor utilization, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and workflow performance.
  • Collaborate with Service, Parts, and Operations teams to maintain a smooth workflow and resolve operational bottlenecks.

Team Leadership & Technician Development:

  • Lead, coach, and support technicians and apprentices, providing guidance to promote productivity, quality, and professional growth.
  • Act as the shop's primary technical resource, offering direction on complex diagnostics, repair processes, and manufacturer best practices.
  • Support onboarding, training, and skill development initiatives to build a strong, capable service team.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement focused on safety, efficiency, quality workmanship, and customer satisfaction.

Customer & Interdepartmental Coordination:

  • Coordinate with Service Advisors, Parts personnel, and other internal departments to support efficient shop operations and timely service completion.
  • Ensure repair updates, changing priorities, and additional work requirements are communicated accurately and promptly to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Facilitate the smooth flow of information, equipment, and resources to help meet customer expectations and operational objectives.
  • Support a positive customer experience by helping ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with established quality standards.

Safety, Shop Standards & Equipment Management:

  • Promote and enforce compliance with company safety policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices to maintain a safe and productive work environment.
  • Ensure technicians use appropriate PPE, tools, equipment, and shop resources safely and in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain high standards of shop organization, housekeeping, and facility readiness to support efficient operations.
  • Oversee the availability, condition, inspection, and maintenance of shop equipment and specialty tools, ensuring damaged or unsafe equipment is removed from service.
  • Identify opportunities to improve shop safety, tooling, equipment, and workplace processes to enhance productivity, quality, and operational performance.

description:
Systems Administrator (Linux & Windows)

Position Overview Type: Full-Time

Location: Fort Huachuca, AZ

Travel: None expected

Work Authorization: U.S. Citizenship required

Summary/Objective

Five Stones Research Corporation (5SRC) is seeking energetic candidates to join our established and growing Huntsville-headquartered team.

Essential Functions

Endpoint Lifecycle Management & MECM/SCCM Administration

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM), managing infrastructure health, site systems, distribution points, and client agent health across all connected enclaves.
  • Engineer, test, deploy, and maintain standardized Windows Operating System Deployment (OSD) task sequences and baseline golden images.
  • Package, test, distribute, and automate application installations, scripts, and software updates across heterogeneous lab and hosting workstations and servers.
  • Manage and orchestrate enterprise-wide software update distribution using Software Update Points (SUP) integrated with Windows Server Update Services (WSUS).
  • Create and deploy custom compliance baselines and configuration items (CIs) to enforce security settings, STIG configurations, registry keys, and audit controls.
  • Develop custom MECM queries, device collections, and reports (SSRS) to provide real-time hardware/software inventory, asset discovery, and compliance auditing.

Systems Administration (Linux & Windows)

  • Administer, build, configure, and maintain physical and virtual Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers, modern Windows Servers (2019/2022), and Windows 10/11 workstations.
  • Manage core directory and identity infrastructure, including Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, DHCP, and role-based access control.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain enterprise Linux services, including SE Linux policies/security contexts, daemon services (systemd, chronyd), file systems (/opt, logical volumes), and local package managers.
  • Maintain hypervisor and storage infrastructure, including Nutanix, VMware ESXi/vCenter, and enterprise backup/restore solutions (e.g., Cohesity, snapshots).
  • Support basic multi-tier database hosting and connectivity for Oracle and Microsoft SQL server backends.
  • Process, approve, and maintain user access documentation and account provisioning via DD Form 2875 and identity management systems.
  • Issue, configure, and troubleshoot Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) certificates, CAC authentication, and secure remote protocols across all client and server endpoints.

Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management & Compliance

  • Maintain strict system security posture in compliance with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and Security Requirements Guides (SRGs).
  • Execute, review, and analyze weekly Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS / Tenable Nessus) vulnerability scans and monthly STIG evaluations.
  • Rapidly remediate identified CVEs, IAVM alerts, CTO/DTO directives, and vendor patches across both Windows and Linux fleets.
  • Draft, track, and update Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) for items requiring architectural mitigations or extended test schedules.
  • Maintain endpoint security agents across all hosts, including Trellix/ePO agents, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and application whitelisting tools (e.g., fapolicyd).
  • Monitor and analyze system, security, and application logs using SIEM and centralized log management tools (e.g., LogRhythm, Elastic Fleet).

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related STEM discipline (equivalent relevant professional experience may be substituted in lieu of degree).
  • Minimum of 3–5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience across mixed Linux (RHEL) and Windows enterprise server/workstation environments.
  • Minimum of 2+ years of dedicated, hands-on administration of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM / SCCM) in an enterprise or lab environment.
  • Active DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II Baseline Certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or SSCP).
  • Relevant computing environment (CE) / vendor training or certification in Microsoft Windows Server/MECM or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (or ability to complete within 6 months of hire).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrable proficiency configuring, operating, and troubleshooting MECM/SCCM (OSD, application packaging, software update deployments, collection management).
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux administration, specifically Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CLI troubleshooting, package management, daemon tuning, and SELinux enforcement.
  • Solid experience with Windows Server (2019/2022) administration, Active Directory, GPO authoring/troubleshooting, and DNS.
  • Experience with DoD vulnerability and compliance tooling: ACAS (Tenable/Nessus), SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC), and STIG Viewer (.ckl generation).
  • Understanding of enterprise backup technologies, bare-metal server recovery, and hypervisor virtualization (Nutanix AHV, VMware).
  • Excellent written communication skills for authoring Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), weekly status reports, and technical troubleshooting documentation.
  • Prior experience administering systems within DoD enterprise testing facilities, operational lab environments, or defense staging enclaves.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and Linux Shell (Bash) scripting to automate routine administration, reporting, and deployment tasks.
  • Hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting enterprise backup appliances (e.g., Cohesity) and application whitelisting tools (e.g., fapolicyd).
  • Familiarity with Elastic Agent/Fleet management, LogRhythm, or enterprise SIEM architectures.
  • Basic understanding of perimeter network components (firewalls, VPNs, F5 BIG-IP load balancers) and cloud hosting environments (AWS GovCloud).

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a mid-to-senior-level Technical Project Manager with strong Business Analysis skills and a solid technical background to lead product development initiatives and manage business-critical projects.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of the product development roadmap, structure ongoing engagements, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution. This person will work closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and leadership to drive product development forward, allowing the existing product lead to focus on commercialization, go-to-market strategy, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Product Roadmap & Technical Project Management

  • Lead the planning, prioritization, and execution of the product development roadmap.

  • Translate product vision and business objectives into actionable plans, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.

  • Coordinate engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of ongoing development initiatives.

  • Establish effective project governance, reporting, and communication processes.

Business Analysis & Requirements Management

  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business and product requirements.

  • Facilitate requirement discovery sessions and ensure alignment between business stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities to improve existing product workflows and processes.

  • Support backlog management and prioritization based on business value, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

Technical Understanding & Delivery Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements, solution approaches, dependencies, and implementation challenges.

  • Understand software development lifecycles, system integrations, APIs, and high-level software architecture.

  • Support technical estimation, sprint planning, release planning, and delivery tracking.

  • Identify technical and delivery risks, coordinate resolution, and communicate potential impacts to stakeholders.

  • Ensure development activities remain aligned with the product roadmap and business objectives.

Engagement Structuring & Stakeholder Management

  • Structure and organize the ongoing client engagement, including scope, workstreams, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Support planning for engagement extensions, future phases, additional initiatives, and evolving business requirements.

  • Work closely with client leadership to identify priorities, clarify expectations, and align delivery plans.

  • Prepare project updates, roadmaps, progress reports, and recommendations for stakeholders.

  • Facilitate effective communication between the client, product leadership, and delivery teams.

  • Help establish a sustainable delivery structure that supports continued product development and future growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, Business Analysis, Product Delivery, or a combination of these disciplines.

  • Proven experience managing software development projects or digital product development initiatives.

  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirement gathering, documentation, stakeholder interviews, and process analysis.

  • Solid technical understanding of software development, APIs, system integrations, and software architecture concepts.

  • Experience translating business requirements into technical tasks, user stories, and development plans.

  • Strong project planning, roadmap management, prioritization, and delivery coordination skills.

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, identify risks, and drive initiatives independently.

  • Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with product-focused engineering teams in a client-facing environment.

  • Exposure to product strategy, product lifecycle management, and release planning.

  • Experience with engagement planning, scope definition, project estimation, and contract or engagement extensions.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based products, SaaS platforms, and modern software development practices.

  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and managing business-critical initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically strong project manager with a business analyst mindset who can take ownership of product development planning and execution. They should be comfortable engaging directly with clients, structuring ongoing work, managing engineering priorities, and ensuring delivery stays aligned with business goals.

This person should be proactive, organized, and capable of operating independently, enabling product leadership to focus on commercialization and marketing while maintaining momentum across product development and other critical initiatives.

  • Seniority: Mid-Senior Level

  • Experience: 5–8+ years

Overview:

We are seeking a driven and experienced Property Manager to take the lead in stabilizing and revitalizing a distressed residential community. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for the day-to-day operations of the property, with a key focus on leasing, collections, maintenance coordination, staff management, and financial performance.   • Smart: You understand people and processes. You collaborate well and adapt to diverse personalities and high-stress situations.

Property Operations & Leadership

  • Oversee all daily property operations, ensuring compliance with company policies, fair housing laws, and local regulations

  • Conduct regular property inspections and coordinate timely maintenance, repairs, and preventive care

  • Manage maintenance service requests, prioritizing urgent items and coordinating with vendors and in-house staff

  • Monitor and enforce lease terms, community rules, and safety policies

  • Handle resident complaints and service issues with discretion, professionalism, and prompt follow-through

  • Supervise all on-site team members including leasing, maintenance, porters, and contractors; handle scheduling, performance evaluations, and coaching

Leasing & Marketing

  • Ensure vacant units are market-ready and that tours, follow-ups, and move-ins are seamless and professional

  • Build strong rapport with prospective and current residents to enhance satisfaction and retention

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Prepare, review, and manage operating budgets in coordination with the Regional Manager

  • Collect rent, process payments, and oversee delinquency tracking, notices, and evictions in accordance with legal guidelines

  • Maintain and monitor property financials including accounts payable/receivable, purchase orders, and vendor contracts

  • Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual reports summarizing key metrics, resident feedback, occupancy trends, and property needs

  • Analyze operational data to make data-driven decisions that improve performance and reduce expenses

Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate and organized resident files, contracts, inspections, incident reports, and vendor documents

  • Ensure all company policies, federal/state/local housing laws, and safety protocols are consistently upheld

  • Train and onboard new team members, including ongoing coaching and performance development

  • Oversee and enforce timely completion of all required administrative duties, such as rent roll updates, delinquency logs, vendor W-9s, and inspection records

  • Create and maintain a resident retention plan including events, communication programs, and reputation management

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in property management, preferably in multifamily residential or distressed property settings

  • Proven success in stabilizing and improving underperforming properties

  • Strong leadership experience, including team hiring, supervision, and performance management

  • Experience using Yardi Voyager, RentCafe, or similar property management software

  • Solid understanding of Fair Housing laws, leasing best practices, and local housing regulations

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-stress environment

  • High level of professionalism, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Must be organized, detail-oriented, and capable of independent decision-making

  • Capable of walking the property regularly, climbing stairs, and lifting up to 25–50 lbs as needed

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Performance-Based Bonuses and Year-End Incentives

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)

  • Generous PTO, Sick Leave & Paid Holidays

  • Career development and advancement opportunities within a growing company

If you are a motivated leader ready to take on the challenge of restoring and transforming a distressed property—and you want to be part of a collaborative, purpose-driven team—we’d love to hear from you

title: Weekend Sign Installer - Smyrna, TN
description:
Artisan Direct is seeking an independent contractor to place and pick up temporary weekend signs in the Smyrna, TN area for the community Hidden Springs.

The contractor will be responsible for installing signs between Friday at 5:00 PM and Saturday at 10:00 AM. The same signs must be picked up between Sunday at 6:00 PM and Monday at 8:00 AM. The work may be performed at any time within those windows, as long as all signs are placed by Saturday at 10:00 AM and removed by Monday at 8:00 AM.

The signs are lightweight corrugated plastic, and are installed on wooden stakes. Artisan Direct provides the signs and stakes and provides replacement inventory as needed.

Job Duties:

  • Use Artisan Direct's mobile application to report installation and pickup of signs at specific locations
  • Install signs every weekend between Friday 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM

  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Artisan Direct and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance. title: Platform Engineer - TS/SCI with CI Polygraph
description:
TITLE: Platform Engineer

LOCATION: McLean, VA

CLEARANCE REQUIRED: Active DoD TS/SCI with CI Poly

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-time, On-site

TRAVEL: 20%

POSITION SUMMARY

Modern Government Solutions (MGS) is seeking a Platform Engineer to design, deploy, maintain, and secure the infrastructure supporting our Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads. You will join a team of platform engineers building and securing enterprise-grade infrastructure and development pipelines, collaborating across the organization to deliver the highest standards in platform reliability and security.

RESPONSIBILITIES (not limited to):

  • Design, deploy, secure, and maintain highly available, scalable Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift, or self-managed), including control plane and worker node architecture.
  • Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Tekton, or Argo Workflows) following GitOps practices with tools such as Argo CD.
  • Provision infrastructure as code using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation, and manage Kubernetes deployments with Helm and Kustomize.
  • Secure Kubernetes environments through RBAC, admission controllers, vulnerability scanning, and secret management tools such as Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, or Splunk) and troubleshoot issues across the full stack.
  • Write automation scripts and custom tooling in Python, Go, or Bash; mentor junior engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Travel up to 20% of the time for on-site installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting at customer sites or data centers.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must possess an active DoD TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance.
  • 5+ years of professional experience designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining Kubernetes-based infrastructure.
  • Current IAM Level II certification to satisfy DOD 8570 IAT requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes networking, including CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium), network policies, service meshes (Istio, Linkerd), and DNS.
  • Hands-on CI/CD and GitOps experience with industry-standard tools.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation) and Kubernetes packaging tools (Helm, Kustomize).
  • Strong Linux/Unix administration skills and solid grasp of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, load balancing).
  • Scripting ability in Python, Go, or Bash, and expert-level Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Deep understanding of DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, with strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Relevant certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  • Experience with Kubernetes operators, custom resource definitions (CRDs), or building internal developer platforms (IDPs).

*Applicants selected will be United States citizens and may be subject to a government security investigation for access to classified information.*

ABOUT US

At MGS, we believe a people-first culture corresponds to organizational success through a commitment to excellence, integrity, inclusion, and an attitude that welcomes challenges meets demands, sustains growth, and drives innovation. We provide expert mission-first technical and programmatic services and solutions for the US intelligence community, the US Department of Defense, and other governmental agencies. We create people-first organizational cultures where employees feel needed in the system, not a system that needs employees. We provide you with long-term career opportunities centrally focused on our core value system: inclusion, integrity, and a commitment to excellence.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

description:
Overview

Who we are

You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.​

This position is based out of the Toyota Motor North America Headquarters in Plano, TX.

Toyota's Digital Innovations group within TMNA's Supply Chain organization is seeking a highly experienced Principal Data Scientist to lead the technical strategy and execution of Supply Chain data science and AI initiatives. This is a technical leadership role that combines deep data science expertise, architectural leadership, and accountability for delivery across complex data, analytics, and software portfolios.


As a Principal Data Scientist, you will shape technical approaches, lead complex modeling and product decisions, and guide execution across development teams in alignment with business priorities. While this role is grounded in principal-level technical leadership, it also requires the ability to develop technical talent, influence delivery practices, and step into direct leadership across one or more technical teams when needed. You will partner with engineering leaders, enterprise architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable decision-support solutions, remove execution barriers, and drive measurable business impact, while advancing AI-enabled delivery capabilities that improve productivity, accelerate learning, and strengthen solution quality.


This position reports to the Senior Manager, Digital Innovations and plays a critical role in advancing data science standards, accelerating digital transformation, and scaling delivery excellence across Supply Chain products.

You will work as part of a fusion team — engineers, product, and Supply Chain operators working to a shared goal and a shared backlog, rather than a technology group taking requests from a business group. This is how Digital Innovations operates. Technical team members are assigned to fusion teams based on priority and need and move between teams and across different parts of the Supply Chain as those priorities shift; in this role you will help set teams up to succeed and keep data science practices consistent as people move.


What you'll be doing


  • Define and advance the technical approach for Supply Chain data science and AI products built on AWS, Databricks, and Azure, ensuring alignment with business priorities, enterprise architecture, data governance, and scalable delivery objectives.
  • Lead architecture and design decisions across data science products and development teams, balancing business value, model quality, explainability, resiliency, security, maintainability, and cost optimization.
  • Provide principal-level technical leadership across the full data science lifecycle, from discovery and problem framing through experimentation, model development, deployment, and operational support for analytics, forecasting, optimization, machine learning, and AI workloads.
  • Mentor data scientists, machine learning engineers, technical leads, and engineering managers to elevate technical excellence and strengthen data science capability across the organization.
  • When needed, directly lead technical work across development teams by setting priorities, coordinating execution, and establishing effective delivery rhythms across parallel workstreams.
  • Drive disciplined execution through scaled agile delivery practices — clear user stories, defined acceptance criteria, effective dependency management, risk mitigation, and measurable outcomes across the data science product lifecycle.
  • Work side by side with product, operations, architecture, and platform partners to turn Supply Chain priorities into actionable technical delivery plans for spend and cost analysis, supplier risk, demand forecasting, scenario planning, document intelligence, and AI-enabled decision support.
  • Lead rigorous technical discussions and challenge model, data, and product decisions to ensure solutions meet business objectives, technical feasibility, responsible AI, data governance, and operational excellence standards.
  • Establish and champion modern data science and MLOps practices — reproducible experimentation, model validation, monitoring, deployment automation, observability, reliability engineering, and high-quality software delivery standards.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies and organizational bottlenecks, and drive alignment and decision-making across data science, engineering, product, and stakeholder groups.
  • Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into technical approaches, delivery health, model performance, risks, tradeoffs, and key decisions.
  • Set the standard for AI-assisted data science: use AI as an assistant in your own work, and define where and how teams apply it to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes — with clear expectations for validation, security, and review.
  • Decide what is worth testing and create the room for the team to test it — running time-boxed experiments and prototypes against models, data, tooling, and emerging technology, and turning what proves out into reusable patterns.
  • Stay close to the operation. Spend time with the buyers, planners, supplier development teams, and other Supply Chain partners who depend on these products so modeling and product decisions reflect how the work actually runs.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, curiosity, experimentation, continuous learning, technical excellence, and inclusive leadership across the data science organization.

What you bring


  • 8+ years designing and delivering complex enterprise data science, machine learning, analytics, or software solutions, including large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • 5+ years of deep experience with cloud-native data science and machine learning architecture on AWS, Databricks, and Azure, distributed compute, modern integration patterns, and scalable product design.
  • 5+ years delivering production data science solutions using technologies such as Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Apache Spark, MLflow, AWS SageMaker or Bedrock, and contemporary MLOps and platform-engineering practices.
  • Demonstrated success shaping technical approaches, influencing across multiple teams, and partnering effectively with engineering, product, architecture, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance technical excellence, delivery outcomes, AI-enabled delivery capabilities, responsible AI, and cost optimization in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated use of AI as an assistant in your own data science work, and experience raising that capability across a team — with the judgment to know where it helps, where it does not, and how to hold quality, security, and review standards.
  • A track record of digging to root cause on hard, ambiguous problems, and of understanding the Supply Chain business problem before reaching for a model or technical solution.
  • Experience leading in a cross-functional team model where technical teams and operations share one goal, and comfort re-forming teams as priorities move.

Technical Expertise


  • Expertise in statistics, machine learning, forecasting, optimization, experimentation, natural language processing, and technical decision-making for scalable data science products.

description:
Job Title: Property Manager / APM
Location: Cincinnati, OH
Job Type: Full Time, On-site
Compensation and Benefits

  • $75k-$80k/year + commensurate with experience

  • Health Insurance

  • PTO and Holiday Pay

Overview:

We are seeking a driven and experienced Property Manager to take the lead in stabilizing and revitalizing a distressed residential community. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for the day-to-day operations of the property, with a key focus on leasing, collections, maintenance coordination, staff management, and financial performance. Reporting directly to the Regional Manager, this individual will play a critical role in bringing the property back to full occupancy, operational efficiency, and resident satisfaction.

The ideal candidate is not just experienced, but also visionary and proactive, with a demonstrated track record of successfully turning around challenged properties, leading teams, and creating sustainable systems.

What Makes You a Fit:

We're looking for an "Ideal Team Player" — someone who is:

  • Humble: You’re experienced but coachable and eager to grow.

  • Hungry: You’re self-motivated, results-driven, and always looking for ways to improve operations and exceed goals.

  • Smart: You understand people and processes. You collaborate well and adapt to diverse personalities and high-stress situations.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Operations & Leadership

  • Oversee all daily property operations, ensuring compliance with company policies, fair housing laws, and local regulations

  • Conduct regular property inspections and coordinate timely maintenance, repairs, and preventive care

  • Manage maintenance service requests, prioritizing urgent items and coordinating with vendors and in-house staff

  • Monitor and enforce lease terms, community rules, and safety policies

  • Handle resident complaints and service issues with discretion, professionalism, and prompt follow-through

  • Supervise all on-site team members including leasing, maintenance, porters, and contractors; handle scheduling, performance evaluations, and coaching

Leasing & Marketing

  • Maintain high occupancy rates through strategic leasing and marketing efforts

  • Oversee and execute property marketing campaigns across multiple platforms (RentCafe, ILS, social media, signage, outreach, etc.)

  • Set and meet leasing goals; review traffic reports and conversion metrics regularly

  • Ensure vacant units are market-ready and that tours, follow-ups, and move-ins are seamless and professional

  • Build strong rapport with prospective and current residents to enhance satisfaction and retention

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Prepare, review, and manage operating budgets in coordination with the Regional Manager

  • Collect rent, process payments, and oversee delinquency tracking, notices, and evictions in accordance with legal guidelines

  • Maintain and monitor property financials including accounts payable/receivable, purchase orders, and vendor contracts

  • Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual reports summarizing key metrics, resident feedback, occupancy trends, and property needs

  • Analyze operational data to make data-driven decisions that improve performance and reduce expenses

Administrative & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate and organized resident files, contracts, inspections, incident reports, and vendor documents

  • Ensure all company policies, federal/state/local housing laws, and safety protocols are consistently upheld

  • Train and onboard new team members, including ongoing coaching and performance development

  • Oversee and enforce timely completion of all required administrative duties, such as rent roll updates, delinquency logs, vendor W-9s, and inspection records

  • Create and maintain a resident retention plan including events, communication programs, and reputation management

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in property management, preferably in multifamily residential or distressed property settings

  • Proven success in stabilizing and improving underperforming properties

  • Strong leadership experience, including team hiring, supervision, and performance management

  • Experience using Yardi Voyager, RentCafe, or similar property management software

  • Solid understanding of Fair Housing laws, leasing best practices, and local housing regulations

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, high-stress environment

  • High level of professionalism, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Must be organized, detail-oriented, and capable of independent decision-making

  • Capable of walking the property regularly, climbing stairs, and lifting up to 25–50 lbs as needed

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Salary: $70k-$80k/year commensurate with experience

  • Performance-Based Bonuses and Year-End Incentives

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)

  • Generous PTO, Sick Leave & Paid Holidays

  • Career development and advancement opportunities within a growing company

Join Our Mission

If you are a motivated leader ready to take on the challenge of restoring and transforming a distressed property—and you want to be part of a collaborative, purpose-driven team—we’d love to hear from you

Logistics Co-ordinator

Where Operations Meet Opportunity.

Fuller Technologies moves industries forward by designing better ways of working — both inside plants and within our own organization. For more than 140 years, we’ve refined processes and engineered solutions that make complex operations run smoother. And the way we work internally follows the same logic: clear roles, smart collaboration, and a culture built to keep improving.

This role ensures that shipments are scheduled, tracked, and delivered efficiently while maintaining compliance with company policies, service level agreements, and applicable trade regulations.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, carriers, warehouses, and freight partners, the Logistics Analyst helps ensure seamless logistics operations and a high level of service delivery. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

  • Support import and export documentation and customs compliance activities.
  • Track logistics costs and assist with freight cost reporting and analysis.
  • Monitor transportation performance against established service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Analyze transportation data to identify trends and recommend process improvements.

.

The signs are lightweight corrugated plastic, and are installed on wooden stakes. Artisan Direct provides the signs and stakes and provides replacement inventory as needed.

Job Duties:

  • Use Directed's mobile application to report installation and pickup of signs at specific locations
  • Install signs every weekend between Friday 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM
  • Pickup the same signs between Sunday 6 PM and Monday 8 AM

  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
  • 18+ years old
  • Reliable vehicle with enough space to transport 30+ signs
  • A smartphone (Android or iPhone), roughly four years old or newer, capable of running our mobile app
  • Ability to lift and place signs and work outdoors
  • Ability to hammer stakes 6–8 inches into the ground during the first weekend only
  • Dependable and able to complete routes within the required time windows each weekend

Independent Contractor Notice

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Directed and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance. Contractors determine their own driving order, provide their own vehicle and mobile device, and complete the work within the placement and pickup windows provided. No benefits, minimum hours, or employment guarantees are offered. Contractors may accept or decline routes but must complete any route they commit to.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer Leader
description:
Jeppesen ForeFlight builds the crew and operations software that many of the world’s leading airlines run on. Our engineers work where rules are exact and mistakes are expensive, alongside around 400 colleagues from more than 50 nations. You will be expected to make a difference.

About the Role

Every airline runs on rules: union agreements, fatigue regulations, company policy and decades of operational exceptions. Our crew and operations systems model every one of them precisely. That depth is why many of the world’s largest airlines run their operations on Jeppesen ForeFlight. It is also why a Crew Tracking implementation is measured in years.

We believe agentic AI changes that equation, and we have evidence. Our engineers already write and review crew-legality rules with Claude Code. The rules compile deterministically into our certified engine, so the engine checks everything an agent writes, and independent review catches what compiles clean but is still wrong. On one project, review caught a rule that let an illegal duty read as compliant, long before go-live. On live airline programmes, our Specification agentic system reads the source agreements clause by clause, finds what is missing before build work starts, and declines to write a requirement it cannot prove.

Now we are building the organisation that runs this at scale: a Forward Deployed Engineering team that works inside customer implementations, operates the agentic systems and builds the hardest parts directly into the product core. We are looking for the leader who will build it and own the result.

You won’t start from a blank page. The model is designed and the first deployments are under way. Your job is to test it against reality and change what the evidence says should change.

The Forward Deployed Unit. Each engagement is run by a Forward Deployed Unit (FDU): one team accountable for one customer outcome, with humans at the edges and agents in the middle. People frame the work and sign off the result, and the agents do most of the reading, reconciling, generating and testing. Some of the people come from our implementation organisation, so you lead the model and its engineering, not every person in it.

From gravel road to paved road. When an engagement hits a gap in the product, FDEs build a narrow, production-grade “gravel road” in the core. Product agrees to the change, Engineering accepts it, and the team paves it into a capability every later customer gets out of the box. FDEs are measured on what later projects never had to build, not on hours billed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the organisation. Hire and lead a Specification Leader, a Development Leader and twelve Forward Deployed Engineers based across the world.
  • Build the FDU model end to end. Run the first deployments, measure what the agentic systems handle unattended and what still needs a person, and redesign the unit based on what you find.
  • Own the agentic systems as programme deliverables. You own the whole: how much they do unattended, how they are evaluated, and where people review their work.
  • Make gravel-to-paved a repeatable habit. Field work merges back into the core every time. Product owns the roadmap and Engineering owns technical acceptance.
  • Protect the mission. Forward-deployed capacity is not spare implementation capacity. You decide which engagements the team takes on, and which it turns down.
  • Be the programme’s voice. Speak to airline executives and our own leadership, and use data to improve the programme and weigh the value created against the investment.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience designing, shipping and running agentic systems in production, including LLM agents, evals and human-in-the-loop controls, and a clear understanding of where they break and why.
  • Technical credibility to read a pull request, challenge an architecture, and debug a drifting agentic system alongside an engineer. Agentic coding tools are part of how you work every day.
  • Experience leading senior engineering teams, ideally distributed or embedded with customers, and a track record of building at least one team from a standing start.
  • Credibility in front of an airline’s leadership team and in front of a sceptical principal engineer.
  • Comfort owning outcomes in mission-critical software, where mistakes are expensive.
  • A habit of leading with evidence and setting up the measurement before claiming the result.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading or working in a forward-deployed engineering model.
  • Experience in airline operations, crew management or another safety-critical domain.
  • A background in optimisation, operations research, scheduling or rule-based systems.
  • Nordic or broader European leadership experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • 90 days: You know every engineer and every active engagement, and you have set the team structure. The baseline measurement framework is agreed, and the criteria for choosing engagements are published.
  • 6 months: Hiring is well under way, and agentic system performance is reported in numbers the business can act on. The first gravel road is paved into the product core. This is a shared outcome with Product and Engineering, who own the roadmap and the acceptance.
  • 12 months: You report leading indicators of shorter implementations: specification phase duration, rules per week through review, defects caught before go-live, and hours later projects did not have to be spent. You have also built a team that strong engineers want to join.

Application

Send your CV (PDF, in English) together with a short note about one agentic system you built: what it did, where it failed, and what you changed because of it.

Why You Should Join

  • A founder’s mandate with backing in place. The roles are approved, the design exists and leadership is behind it. The team is yours to build.
  • AI where correctness matters. You’ll work with hundreds of interacting rules, certified engines and optimisers in the agentic systems. Agents do the work, and a deterministic core underneath keeps it honest.
  • A serious engineering home. Our Gothenburg office is one of the city’s largest software development organisations.

Our benefits package includes, but is not limited to:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Employer paid life, AD&D, and long term disability insurance
  • Health and wellness reimbursement allowance
  • Pension plan
  • 30 paid vacation days, as well as additional days off for Christmas break
  • Employee assistance program
  • 2 days off to volunteer annually
  • Employee referral program
  • Flight rewards and flight stipend
